artworks.title: Easthampton, Sidewalk
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a tree-lined avenue from the perspective at the start of the path. The horizon is suggested by the convergence of the trees and path in the distance. A faint silhouette of a figure walking away can be seen on this horizon. The artwork features fine ink lines forming detailed crosshatching for shadows and texture in an etching style. Evenly spaced tree trunks with contrasting shadows guide the eyes along the path, next to a wooden fence on the right. Vintage automobiles and buildings are visible beyond the trees, on the left side. The color palette is monochromatic, utilizing black ink variations on a cream background to portray forms and light.

artworks.title: Floor of the Stock Exchange
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large indoor space with high ceilings, arched doorways, and decorative panels on the walls. Various groups of people are gathered around tall equipment or fixtures in the room. The drawing shows detailed line work and shading to create depth and texture, capturing the lively atmosphere and architectural elements of the space.

artworks.title: Giant Elm, Easthampton
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from ground level of a large tree dominating the scene. The tree's canopy and trunk take up much of the visual space. In the background, a building with multiple windows is partially obscured by the foliage. The etching technique features detailed cross-hatching, providing texture to the tree and structure. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. Shadows cast by the tree's branches create visual interest on the ground.

artworks.title: Winter
artworks.medium: oil and watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Bessie Potter Vonnoh Keyes, 1955)
artworks.description: The image displays swirling and flowing shapes in a dynamic composition. The design features earthy tones with splashes of red, green, and blue. The shapes resemble organic forms like waves or smoke. Some areas evoke textures of a rocky landscape or marbled surface. There is a visual complexity with intertwining colors similar to natural stone patterns or weathered surfaces.

artworks.title: Edward St. Germain and his sister Delia, mill workers, Phoenix, Rhode Island, April 1909
artworks.medium: gelatin silver print
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Harry H. Lunn, Jr., through Graphics International Ltd., 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of young individuals standing in front of a wooden building with horizontal siding. Two children are fully visible in the foreground, while parts of two others are partially visible on either side of the image. In the center, a girl stands with her body facing forward, one hand on her hip, and her hair pulled back. She wears a checkered short-sleeve dress with a white apron covering the front and dark stockings. Beside her, a boy stands upright facing the camera, dressed in a double-breasted jacket, knee-length shorts, dark stockings, and a cap. He has short hair underneath the cap. Both are standing on a dirt ground. The building behind them features windows, with visible figures peering through one of the windows. The windows have multiple panes.

artworks.title: David et Goliath
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting David and Goliath. The artwork features a large figure on the left, armed with a curved sword. He wears a large cap with a feather and a massive cloak. On the right, a smaller figure is depicted in a dynamic stance. He is dressed in a simple outfit and carries a sling in his hand. The background includes a row of tents, suggesting a military camp setting. The line work is bold, and the figures are exaggerated for dramatic effect.

artworks.title: The Heart of the Andes
artworks.artist: William Forrest, after Frederic Edwin Church
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1989)
artworks.description: This print shows a detailed landscape featuring mountains, green foliage, plants, and trees, with a path on the left and a waterfall cascading into a pool in the center. The scene is depicted from a slightly elevated perspective, capturing the textures and intricate details of the landscape. The color palette consists mainly of greens, browns, and blues. The print is surrounded by a border of beige paper.

artworks.title: Cloetis
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Edward M. East, 1948)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a building on the right side and trees framing it. The painting is executed in a watercolor technique, featuring warm and earthy colors. In the foreground, a young boy in a red jacket walks down a path. Various trees surround the building, adding scale and depth to the scene.

artworks.title: St. Cloud
artworks.artist: American 19th Century after John Frederick Kensett
artworks.medium: graphite with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a river landscape with a gently curving river flowing through. A distant rolling hill is visible near the horizon, with a bridge spanning across the river. The brushstrokes are sketch-like, with fine pencil lines on tan paper. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey. Rocks line the riverbank, and a few figures with a horse are present. Structures and trees line the riverbanks, creating a calm countryside scene.

artworks.title: Cannon Trailers, France
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a covered, wheeled vehicle. The drawing depicts an artillery piece or cannon mounted on large, spoked wheels. Parts of the equipment are covered with cloth or tarpaulin. The sketch is executed with pencil, with shading and outlines to give form to the machinery. Various mechanical details and structural elements are suggested by light, precise lines.

artworks.title: Italian Villa [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated point, looking down over a group of buildings partially obscured by trees. The horizon is at the top third of the image, meeting a sky with soft clouds. The buildings and cypress trees create vertical elements contrasting with the horizontal landscape. The style features sketch-like graphite strokes suggesting form, giving a misty appearance. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of grey against a pale paper tone, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Study for "The Eclipse of the Sun by the Moon"
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on green wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a winged figure seated with a relaxed posture. The figure has long flowing hair, closed or semi-closed eyes, and is lightly dressed. They hold a stick touching an open book on their lap. The figure's wings are spread out against a large spherical object in the background. The setting has a lightly shaded background with subtle gradients.

artworks.title: Political Cartoon of the American Civil War
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on blue-gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of six panels depicting scenes with allegorical figures. The sketches are divided into six distinct panels, each illustrating a different allegorical scene. Each panel features figures with exaggerated gestures and attire reminiscent of Classical Greek or Roman mythology. Elements include figures wearing various headdresses and holding shields, horns, or other classical attributes. The setting is simplistic to focus on the figures' actions and interactions. Handwritten annotations accompany each panel, explaining or naming the depicted event or concept.

artworks.title: New York—Street Scene
artworks.medium: graphite and wash on blue-gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: The image depicts a grayscale drawing of a crowded urban scene, with figures and carriages. Buildings and trees can be seen in the background, with fine and detailed pencil strokes creating a sense of motion. The drawing has a monochromatic color palette, emphasizing shading and line work. Closest to the viewer, people and horses are depicted in dynamic poses, surrounded by a bustling atmosphere. In the distance, more individuals are engaged in various activities, with a tree on the right adding a natural element.

artworks.title: Study for "Pêcheurs de la mer du Nord" (Study for "Fishermen of the North Sea")
artworks.medium: charcoal, graphite, and colored pencil on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of  Mrs. Eugene Vail, wife of the artist, 1948)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a three-quarters view position, balancing a round object on their head with both hands. The person has short, dark hair, basic facial features, and is wearing a loose-fitting long-sleeved shirt, pants, and boots. In the background, there is a lightly sketched second figure to the left and a gridded drawing paper marked with blue lines.

artworks.title: The First Snowfall
artworks.medium: watercolor and pastel on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Arthur B. Davies, wife of the artist, 1930)
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene from a slightly elevated perspective, with trees creating a sense of depth. The horizon is not clearly visible due to the dense foliage. In the distance, there is a suggestion of a small structure among the trees. The artwork features delicate brushstrokes, defined pencil lines, and subtle washes for an atmospheric effect. The color palette consists of muted browns, greens, and grays with hints of blues and darker tones. A small animal, possibly a dog or wolf, is partially visible in the foreground.

artworks.title: Nine Figures
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on laid paper mounted to paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Emily Crane Chadbourne, 1931)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of eight women in various poses. They are depicted in full-body views, with different hairstyles and expressions. The women appear unclothed, with a neutral background.

artworks.title: Tropical Plant [recto]
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice Stanely Acheson, daughter of the artist, 1963)
artworks.description: The image shows a large, green yucca plant with spiky leaves in the center of the composition. The predominant colors are green, blue, earthy brown, yellow, and white in the background sky. The plant stands upright in the foreground, with its leaves extending outward, while the background features soft colors and shapes suggesting sky and landscape.

artworks.title: Head of a Girl
artworks.medium: silverpoint on prepared wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of James Parmelee, 1941)
artworks.description: The head and neck of a girl is drawn with layers of delicate, faint silverpoint lines on vertically oriented, cream-white paper. The girl is angled to our right and looks off in that direction with shaded eyes. She has broad, high cheekbones, a straight nose, and her full lips are closed with a faint suggestion of a smile and a dimple in the cheek we see. Her hair is parted down the middle and pulled loosely back and up. Her shoulders below the neck are sparsely sketched in. The drawing is done with fine, almost ghostly lines, which gives the portrait an ethereal, insubstantial look. The artist signed the drawing in the lower right corner, “T W Dewing.”

artworks.title: Quittant le valachie
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of caricatures in a scene set in Valachie (now known as Wallachia). The image shows a person wearing a large hat and flowing clothes moving away from a sign that reads "VALACHIE". Another character in simple clothing appears puzzled or surprised, while a third figure runs in the background holding a spear or a long weapon. The drawing style resembles satirical political cartoons from the mid-19th century, using exaggeration and humor to convey a message or critique. The image appears to depict themes of departure or escape from Wallachia, with a caption highlighting the urgency of the main figure's exit.

artworks.title: Renan
artworks.medium: Woodburytype
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, standing with his body slightly leaning against a large column to his left. His arms are crossed at the waist, and he is holding a rolled document in one hand, along with a narrow cylindrical object. The man has a contemplative expression, with a strong, defined nose, medium-set eyes, and a high forehead. His hair is dark, parted on the side, and combed back. He is dressed in formal attire, consisting of a dark suit with a waistcoat and a white dress shirt, topped with a bow tie, and a long overcoat draping down. The background is simple, featuring a flat, neutral tone with a portion of the ornately styled column visible.

artworks.title: Tooth Extraction
artworks.medium: black ink wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Claude J. Ranney, grandson of the artist, 1960)
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals shown from approximately mid-thigh upwards. The figures are engaged in an interaction where they seem to be physically engaging with each other. The person on the left has their arms raised and hands clenched, wearing a large brimmed hat. The figure in the center is leaning forward, with only their legs and a partial upper body visible. The person on the right is facing left, leaning slightly towards the central figure, and wearing a hat with a feather. All individuals are in simple, loose clothing with features like wide-brim hats and boots evident. The background is plain and consists of a minimalistic, monochrome wash.

artworks.title: Dragoon with His Charger
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Claude J. Ranney, grandson of the artist, 1960)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing beside a horse. The man has his arm resting on the horse's back, while holding a sword. He has distinct facial features with a beard and is wearing a military-style uniform with a helmet, epaulets, a sash, and tall boots. The horse has a bridle and saddle. The background features simple lines indicating a ground surface and sketchy plant-like elements.

artworks.title: Cathedral Ruins, Bacharach
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: The image features a drawing of a ruined Gothic structure viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The architectural elements such as pointed arches and delicate tracery are emphasized. The horizon is subtly suggested in the backdrop. The ruins are positioned prominently in the center of the composition, with a series of stone steps leading upwards. The brushstrokes are soft and intricate, capturing the details of the stone and brickwork, while washes add depth and shadow. The color palette is subdued with shades of gray, reddish-brown, and hints of greenery. A tree is depicted on the left side with its foliage sketched lightly in contrast to the architectural lines.
